name: Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser
description: The Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser, also designated as the Cantwell-class 410 cruiser and shortened as the Cantwell-class cruiser, was a type of cruiser used by the Galactic Empire. Manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards at the request of the Department of Imperial Justice and the Imperial Navy, it featured three powerful tractor beam projectors which it used to ensnare suspect vessels and steer traffic away from construction zones. One Arrestor was notably featured in an Imperial recruitment film that was displayed in the Coronet City Spaceport. Several Arrestors were deployed to the construction site of the DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station over Scarif along with an Imperial-class Star Destroyer.

data.name: Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser
armament: Primary articulated RT-17 repulsor-tractor beam emitter (forward bow-mounted)
Secondary RT-17 repulsor-tractor beam emitters (2) (one portside and one starboard-side mounted)
Light laser cannons (12) (three forward, three aft, three port and three starboard-mounted)
complement: At least one TIE boarding craft
Various shuttles, landing craft, and utility vehicles
